events.label: birth
events.text: Born in London.

evidence.quote: 20 November 1851

events.text: Went on to University College London.

evidence.quote: in 1868 at University College London

events.text: Published edition of Plautus's Captivi.

evidence.quote: publishing editions of Captivi ( 1879 )

events.text: Appointed professor of Greek and Latin at Mason College.

evidence.quote: appointed Oxford professor of Greek and Latin at Mason College ( afterwards the University of Birmingham ) in 1883

events.label: Plautus
events.text: Published Bentley's Plautine emendations from his copy of Gronovius (first of 6 editions, 1883-1963)

evidence.quote: Bentleys Plautine emendations from his copy of Gronovius by Richard Bentley , 6 editions between 1883 and 1963

events.text: Published edition of Plautus's Mostellaria.

evidence.quote: Mostellaria ( 1884 )

events.text: Published edition of Plautus's Rudens.

evidence.quote: Rudens ( 1891 )

events.label: grammar
events.text: Published A Greek Grammar for Schools (first of 18 editions, 1898-1929)

evidence.quote: A Greek Grammar for Schools ; based on the principles and requirements of the Grammatical Society , 18 editions between 1898 and 1929

events.label: Latin
events.text: Published Ora Maritima, a Latin story for beginners (first of 10 editions, 1902-1927)

evidence.quote: Ora Maritima ; a Latin story for beginners , 10 editions between 1902 and 1927

events.label: founding
events.text: Founded the Classical Association with John Percival Postgate.

evidence.quote: With John Percival Postgate , he founded the Classical Association in 1903

events.text: Became Secretary of the Classical Association.

evidence.quote: forming the Classical Association in 1903 , becoming its Secretary

events.text: Published The Unity of the Latin Subjunctive.

evidence.quote: The Unity of the Latin Subjunctive ( 1910 )

events.text: Contributed articles to the 1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica.

evidence.quote: He contributed to the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica

events.label: grammar
events.text: Published A New Latin Grammar based on the Joint Committee recommendations (first of 11 editions, 1912-1925)

evidence.quote: A New Latin Grammar : based on the recommendations of the Joint Committee on Grammatical Terminology , 11 editions between 1912 and 1925

events.label: Classical Association
events.text: Published Recommendations of the Classical Association on the teaching of Latin and Greek

evidence.quote: Recommendations of the Classical Association on the teaching of Latin and Greek , 2 editions in 1912

events.label: German
events.text: Published Through German Eyes (first of 11 editions, 1914-1915)

evidence.quote: Through German Eyes , 11 editions between 1914 and 1915

events.text: Son Christopher Edward killed in a Swiss mountaineering accident.

evidence.quote: killed in a mountaineering accident in Switzerland on 22 February 1914

events.label: grammar
events.text: Published A new English Grammar based on the Joint Committee recommendations (first of 17 editions, 1916-1962)

evidence.quote: A new English Grammar based on the recommendations of the Joint Committee on Grammatical Terminology , 17 editions between 1916 and 1962

events.text: Left the Mason College professorship.

evidence.quote: staying there until 1918

events.label: Latin
events.text: Published The Gateway, a book of Latin composition for middle forms

evidence.quote: The Gateway ; a book of Latin composition for middle forms , 4 editions in 1924

events.label: essay
events.text: Published the essay What is Rhythm?

evidence.quote: What is Rhythm ? An essay , 2 editions in 1925

events.text: Published The Soul of Grammar.

evidence.quote: The Soul of Grammar ( 1927 )

events.label: death
events.text: Died in Bath.

evidence.quote: 2 September 1929
